purpose: Test whether a same-core English self-transcript creates useful lexical evidence and whether a cross-fitted training-free controller can convert that evidence into a reliable improvement over frozen one-call M0.

predecessor.verdict: all 103 recovery samples returned a response, but the strict semantic-factor parser accepted zero; no BM25 candidate existed and no evidence-use or scorer phase opened
predecessor.required_change: acquire a plain English linguistic observation that is independently known to be live, preserve a batch-level liveness stop before evidence use, and do not relax or retry the closed strict-factor interface

independent_motivation: the earlier 60-sample speech cascade routed 45 of 60 frozen-core self-transcripts with the preregistered text-retrieval threshold
the frozen Audio2Tool perfect-transcript lexical ceiling reached 0.7925 top-5 recall while the one-call A2T-G1-104 tool accuracy was 0.5962
the failed factor probe localized its failure to strict structured observation rather than model response liveness

unchanged: A2T-G1-104 sample identities and speech-feature packets
frozen core and API-shaped service boundary
complete 152-tool task contract on final-answer contacts
official scorer and exact-match primary outcome
single_information_change.changed: replace the dead strict semantic-factor observation with a plain English same-core self-transcript, retrieve frozen knowledge content with deterministic BM25, and supply a bounded matched evidence bundle
not_allowed: repairing, relaxing, or retrying the predecessor factor schema
reference transcripts, gold labels, scores, rewards, test annotations, or future turns on a runtime path
post-result transcript filters, BM25 settings, evidence budgets, state bins, support rules, or promotion-threshold changes

population.strata: 13 samples per tier across all eight tiers
population.exposure: fully exposed discovery cohort; all findings are secondary mechanism evidence and cannot revise the locked engineering baseline

frozen_m0_outputs.semantics: one-call baseline and STOP_M0 output, reused without model contact

knowledge_snapshot.construction: block-disjoint English training content; no reference transcript or discovery/test annotation

prompt_fit_receipt.dominance_rule: the final contact must not exceed the landed envelope of one agent state, five facets, six values, the complete task contract, and 1024 completion tokens

agent_loop.frozen_core: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct Q4_K_M through a receipt-pinned local llama.cpp API-shaped service
agent_loop.phase_barrier: finish and seal every OBS_SELF_TRANSCRIPT response, evaluate only label-free liveness, and stop the experiment if the batch gate fails before starting any USE contact
agent_loop.phase_1: OBS_SELF_TRANSCRIPT: one speech-only same-core contact receives the original speech and an ASR-only English instruction; it receives no registry, knowledge value, M0 response, gold, or task-answer schema
agent_loop.phase_2: ORG_RETRIEVE: an offline deterministic parser validates the transcript and deterministic local BM25 ranks the frozen knowledge snapshot; no model, embedding, tokenizer, HTTP, or socket contact is allowed
agent_loop.phase_3_main: USE_MATCHED: one final same-core contact receives the original speech, the validated English self-transcript as traced AgentState, the complete frozen task contract, and the matched bounded evidence bundle
agent_loop.phase_3_control: USE_SHUFFLED_EVIDENCE: one final same-core contact receives the same original speech, its own validated self-transcript AgentState, the same task contract, and an equal-budget evidence bundle retrieved from a deterministic same-tier deranged donor transcript
agent_loop.invalid_or_unavailable_semantics: return frozen M0 without a USE contact; rejected transcript text never enters a later model context
agent_loop.final_authority: only a USE_MATCHED frozen-core response or frozen M0 can be the proposed policy answer; transcript responses, retriever state, and shuffled-control responses are never final policy authority

self_transcript_contract.instruction: Transcribe the English speech verbatim. Output only the spoken English words. Do not answer the request, infer missing content, emit JSON, or name a tool. If a word is unclear, write the most likely English word without commentary.
self_transcript_contract.canonicalization: strip surrounding ASCII whitespace, normalize CRLF to LF, require one nonempty line, collapse internal ASCII whitespace, and preserve the remaining ASCII letters, digits, apostrophes, hyphens, and sentence punctuation
validity: ASCII printable characters only and at least one ASCII letter
at least 0.80 of alphanumeric tokens contain an ASCII letter
not valid JSON and not fenced code
does not contain a tool-call object, role prefix, model commentary, or refusal marker
self_transcript_contract.invalid_semantics: record the structural rejection reason, force STOP_M0, and never place the rejected text in another model context

label_free_batch_liveness_gate.failure: seal a negative liveness result, make no USE or resend contact, do not open gold or an official scorer, and close this self-transcript interface on A2T-G1-104

retriever.algorithm: deterministic Okapi BM25 over frozen English content facets
retriever.tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens after camel-case splitting
retriever.candidate_rule: rank positive-score facets by descending BM25 score, then stable facet identity; keep the first five facets after deterministic deduplication

evidence_budget.renderer: the existing canonical Audio2Tool knowledge renderer

retriever.unavailable_rule: no positive facet score means no route and forces STOP_M0
invariances: ASCII whitespace variation in the query

shuffled_evidence_control.assignment: within each tier, sort routed sample ids by SHA-256 of shuffled-evidence-v1 plus sample_id and rotate donor transcripts by one position
shuffled_evidence_control.derangement: no sample can donate its own transcript; every routed sample receives exactly one donor and is used exactly once as a donor within its tier
shuffled_evidence_control.final_agent_state: the recipient's own validated self-transcript remains visible
shuffled_evidence_control.retrieval_query: the donor self-transcript is used only by the deterministic retriever and is not rendered into the final model context
shuffled_evidence_control.purpose: measure whether matched evidence adds information beyond a second same-core contact, the self-transcript AgentState, and the fixed evidence budget

coarse: M0 parse relation to matched top-5 targets: intersects, known-disjoint, unresolved
normalized BM25 top-1 margin: below-0.15, at-least-0.15
positive facet count: one, two-to-five, six-or-more
detailed_additions: transcript word count: one-to-four, five-to-eight, nine-or-more
distinct task targets in supplied evidence: one, two-to-three, four-to-five
runtime_state.margin_definition: top1-minus-top2 divided by max(top1, 1e-12); a missing top2 has margin 1
forbidden: literal transcript text or token identity
knowledge facet, value, registry domain, or category identity
sample id, query_idx, rendition id, tier, donor id, or fold as a feature
gold labels, correctness, score, reward, USE response, shuffled response, or future turn

training_free_reward_memory.type: five-fold whole-query-group cross-fitted hierarchical exact-cell action-return memory
training_free_reward_memory.decision: use the most-specific other-fold matching cell, detailed before coarse; select USE_MATCHED only with support at least four, at least two exact-match saves, and zero exact-match harms; otherwise STOP_M0
training_free_reward_memory.candidate_selection: the hierarchy and thresholds are frozen; no policy-family search is allowed after labels open
training_free_reward_memory.contact_accounting: every deployable sample pays one self-transcript contact; only USE_MATCHED pays a final-answer contact; frozen M0 remains the one-call baseline

resend_control.selection: after matched route availability is frozen but before any USE response is semantically read, choose two routed samples per tier by the smallest SHA-256 of resend-self-transcript-v1 plus sample_id
resend_control.protocol: repeat the byte-identical USE_MATCHED model request through a fresh gated attempt with the same request id, slot id, speech packet, decoding parameters, AgentState, supplied evidence, task contract, and control instruction
resend_control.scoring: create a complete 104-row resend composite by replacing only the 16 selected matched responses and retaining matched or frozen-M0 responses for the other rows
resend_control.floor: record request-hash equality, byte divergence, parsed-call divergence, exact-match divergence, and the absolute matched-versus-resend-composite exact-count difference
resend_control.promotion_binding: cross-fitted policy exact gain must exceed the measured absolute complete-manifest resend exact-count difference

evaluation.seal_before_score: all observation, matched, shuffled-evidence, and resend contacts and all complete output manifests seal before gold or scorer results are opened
evaluation.official_scorer: invoke the existing authoritative scorer unchanged and single-process once for each complete manifest

wave_2_jobs: cross-fitted policy complete 104-row composite after the fixed policy is composed
outer_parallelism.aggregation: never shard a dataset for official scoring and never average shard-level metrics
outer_parallelism.equivalence_gate: every parallel result must be verified, bind the expected complete-manifest identity, and match an unchanged official-scorer invocation
outer_parallelism.efficiency_report: record wall time, sum of per-job times, effective speedup, worker count, storage pressure, result hashes, and scorer identity; scoring speed is not a scientific promotion gate

mandatory_reports: M0, always-use matched, shuffled-evidence, resend, and cross-fitted policy exact match, tool accuracy, and slot micro-F1
observation response rate, transcript validity and rejection reasons, word-count distribution, diversity, and prohibited-structure leakage
BM25 route rate, top-1 margin, positive-facet count, top-5 gold-tool recall on the scoring side only, and evidence-target diversity
matched-minus-M0, matched-minus-shuffled, and policy-minus-M0 grouped paired deltas and CI90
policy saves, harms, net gain, action rate, observation contacts, final contacts, and total contacts per sample
all eight tiers without tier-conditioned tuning and all five whole-query-group folds
state-cell support, signed-return mixing, and every selected cell's other-fold provenance
resend request identity, byte, parsed-call, metric, timing, and slot-id divergence
parallel scorer wall time, per-job time, effective speedup, result hashes, complete-manifest identities, and scorer identity

decision_ladder.liveness_failure: write a negative artifact, make no USE contact, close this self-transcript interface on the current cohort, and do not open gold or scorer
decision_ladder.scientific_failure: write a negative artifact, close this matched self-transcript BM25 evidence mechanism on the current cohort, and make no fresh-sample contact
decision_ladder.success: freeze the exact observation, retriever, evidence renderer, controller, and gates; then preregister a separate block-disjoint approximately-104-sample prospective support flight without opening it under this contract
decision_ladder.support_success: only a separately registered stable prospective gain may propose an approximately-1000-sample Stage-2 engineering validation; no larger run is authorized here
decision_ladder.large_validation_success: only replicated approximately-100 and approximately-1000 gains may propose a new engineering-baseline lock; Stage-3, test, and paper-scale claims remain separately gated
decision_ladder.no_failure_followup: do not alter transcript acceptance, BM25, top-k, evidence budget, shuffle, state bins, support, harm, or promotion gates on these returns

precontact_requirements: implementation and tests are committed with at least 80 percent targeted branch coverage
structured contracts.ExecutionPlan files are committed with this row as exposure_pre_registration_id
